segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin report the scrub keeps oil under control during the day and helps with acne without extra irritation, though one found it a bit too coarse for her liking.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as gentle enough for daily use, leaving skin soft rather than stripped, though several others with dry skin report it left their face extremely dry with tiny bumps or breakouts.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin (including oily T-zone types) describe it as balancing, non-drying, and helpful for texture and pores.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many say it is unusually gentle, non-irritating, and even calms redness, while a distinct minority report it caused dryness, bumps, burning, or their worst breakout in years.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her late 40s with mature skin reports it calms redness and leaves skin soft; another mature-skin user found it brightening with a more youthful look after a week.

concerns.aging: Two mature reviewers report brighter, more youthful-looking, smoother skin after regular use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it does not dry out skin and even helps dry patches or under-hydrated skin, but several others explicitly report it left their face very dry, especially with hot water.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive, aging skin reports it calms redness; no one reports increased redness from the product itself, though eye contact is noted to sting.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes it as too harsh long-term for sensitive/dry skin ('doesn't rip my face off' framing) and notes a preference for using it less often to avoid stripping the skin biome; most others report no stripping.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers with blackhead- or pore-prone skin report the scrub action helps with pores and blackheads over time; no dissent noted on this specific point.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report clearer skin and fewer breakouts, including some describing it as clearing acne within days; however, multiple others (including long-time Origins users) report their worst breakouts ever, patchy dry skin, or raised, hard-to-hide pimples after use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily and combination reviewers report the product keeps oil under control and reduces redness/oiliness through the day; one found it slightly too coarse but continued using it for this effect.

extraits.texte: I've been using Origins for 5+ years and use most products from the Ginzing line daily. I normally use the Cheeks & Balances face wash but decided to try the Ginzing cleanser on my most recent purchase. I DO NOT recommend for sensitive skin. My entire face is broken out, patchy, and dry (I never have acne). This is the only new facial product I've used in months.

Probably the worst cleanser I have used from Origins, I am a long time fan of the frothy face and decided to try this line. It leaves my face extremely dry and I have developed tiny little bumps on my face from it. I wouldn't recommended this product to anyone who has sensitive skin. Stick to the frothy face

I did not feel compelled to leave a review until reading all of the negatives. I purchased this in a discounted Christmas gift set without any prior expectations. I had been struggling all year with horrible breakouts and this line of products cleared my skin! I use the Ginzing cleanser, moisturizer, and brightening serum daily. I have had sensitive skin my whole life and recommend this product!

extraits.titre: Got a trial, will buy full size
extraits.texte: I was interested in finding an exfoliator and got a trial size tube of this scrub. First of all, love the clean citrus scent! I like the cooling gel texture too. I like that it foams up as well as exfoliates, but it has not dried out my skin like Checks & Balances does. I use it once a week to cleanse and slough off flaky skin, since I have combination skin with an oily T-Zone that can get dry in some spots. Keeps oil under control. I am prone to breakouts, but this does not make me break out. Makes my skin feel balanced and never dry/stripped.

I have been using this product for about a week and nothing has made an immediate impact on my skin so quickly. It looks so smooth and clear. I honestly look brighter and more youthful. I picked this up on a whim and had zero expectations. A product doesn't need to be abrasive to exfoliate your skin and a little goes a long way. I have combination/oily skin and find my skin less oily during the day.

My mother in law received a sample of this from the Estee Lauder company and gave it to me. I loved it and bought it! I have oily combination skin and Ive been having some bunpy texture problems too. This scrub gets everything though and it leaves my skin feels like brand new. Although I would say it is a tad too coarse for my liking, but ill still use it cause its great. I wouldn't recommend for sensitive/dry skin.

extraits.titre: A staple in my skincare routine ♥️
extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin , especially as I'm getting older (47) can't use highly fragrances products etc.. this has helped calm my redness and my skin is so soft afterwards. Because of the great ingredients with natural oils, it lathers really great so you don't need much at all for your face and neck. At 5 oz , you really get your money's worth. It's a keeper, love it 🥰
